description:
Ju-Eun escaped from Korea to London―to find herself entrapped in the blue eyes of a particular singer. In her third year of being in London, she met and fell for Eden―a tall, blond, tattooed, gorgeous, and gifted musician in a punk band―a dangerously alluring man accepting of all and wanted by all. And with that, Ju-Eun's once-plain life in London takes a drastic turn. She is willing to love just Eden, but will Eden come to love only Ju-Eun?
